title: Commerce, Justice, Science, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2027
last_action: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 567.
status: Reported by House Appropriations; Union Calendar
summary: The House-reported FY2027 CJS bill and report provide up to $15 million for the Center for AI Standards and Innovation, including a hardware-security and secure-location-verification grant program. The report also directs work on an AI lifecycle-security framework, open-source model security risks, small-business AI resources, and at least $30 million for advancement of the National AI Research Resource.
committee_dynamics: This is the House's principal FY2027 funding vehicle for NIST, CAISI, NSF, and related federal AI evaluation and research capacity. It was reported from committee but had not passed the House; the final funding outcome can change through floor action, continuing resolutions, or a later consolidated appropriations measure.
advance_rationale: Even without standalone passage, its funding and report directions can shape final appropriations negotiations and federal AI-security capacity.
verification_level: Bill details updated from Congress.gov on 2026-10-30.
